seo.meta_description: Full Panera Bread menu with prices and calories for 2026: sandwiches, Broccoli Cheddar soup, mac and cheese, salads, You Pick Two, bagels and bakery.

price_disclaimer: Prices and calories are approximate. Sandwich prices are for a whole; a half is cheaper and pairs in You Pick Two. Soups are cup / bowl / bread bowl. Prices vary by location (cafe and delivery pricing differ). Last updated October 2026.
intro: Panera Bread is the bakery-cafe known for its Broccoli Cheddar soup in a bread bowl, the You Pick Two combo, fresh-baked bagels, warm sandwiches, salads and a big drinks lineup including the Unlimited Sip Club. It's built around 'fast casual' food made to order. Sandwiches come whole or half, and soups come in a cup, a bowl or a bread bowl. Below is the full Panera Bread menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: A whole sandwich at Panera is about $11.99 to $12.99, a cup of Broccoli Cheddar soup is $6.99 (bread bowl $10.49), and mac and cheese is $5.99 a cup. The You Pick Two combo (a half sandwich plus a cup of soup, mac or salad) is $13.99. The Broccoli Cheddar soup and You Pick Two are the signatures.
hot_deal: Panera value: the Unlimited Sip Club (about $14.99 a month) gets unlimited drip coffee, tea and fountain drinks and pays for itself fast for regulars. MyPanera rewards drops free items and birthday treats, and the You Pick Two ($13.99) is the best way to try two things at once. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is You Pick Two at Panera?
faqs.a: You Pick Two lets you combine two half-size items: a half sandwich, a cup of soup, a cup of mac and cheese, or a half salad. It is about $13.99, and an adult combo adding a drink and a side is about $16.99. It is the most popular way to order.

faqs.q: How much is Panera's Broccoli Cheddar soup?
faqs.a: A cup is about $6.99, a bowl $8.99, and in a bread bowl about $10.49. It is Panera's signature soup, a cup is around 240 calories and a bowl 360. The bread bowl adds the calories of the bread.

faqs.q: What is the Unlimited Sip Club?
faqs.a: The Unlimited Sip Club is a subscription, about $14.99 a month, for unlimited drip hot coffee, hot tea, iced coffee, iced tea and fountain drinks on every visit. For regular coffee drinkers it pays for itself in a few visits.

faqs.q: How many calories are in a Panera sandwich?
faqs.a: A whole Bacon Turkey Bravo is about 730 calories and a Chipotle Chicken Avocado Melt about 830. Ordering a half in You Pick Two, or pairing with a lighter cup of soup or salad, keeps the meal down.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Panera?
faqs.a: The best known are the Broccoli Cheddar soup, the You Pick Two combo, the Bacon Turkey Bravo, the mac and cheese, and the Chipotle Chicken Avocado Melt.
